protocol_meta.target_scope: minimal CoAP over UDP server subset for planning-agent debugging

channels.name: main
channels.purpose: Carries one complete CoAP message per UDP datagram between external clients and the server.

runtime_implications.summary: The server runtime should bind a UDP socket, receive datagrams with peer endpoint metadata, and send encoded responses with sendto.
Packet decoding is datagram-scoped; the implementation does not maintain stream buffers, message fragmentation buffers, or per-peer connection objects.
The UDP event loop uses epoll on a nonblocking IPv4 datagram socket and reads datagrams up to the fixed receive buffer size.

roles.name: client
roles.summary: External CoAP clients send CON or NON method requests over UDP and receive ACK or NON responses from the server.

roles.name: server
roles.summary: The generated target is a CoAP server that decodes requests, builds a request view from URI and content options, dispatches to in-memory resources, and encodes responses.

interaction_units.name: datagram_message
interaction_units.summary: Each protocol unit is a binary CoAP message decoded from one UDP datagram with a 4-byte header, optional token, ordered options, and optional payload.

interaction_units.name: resource_request
interaction_units.summary: A method request is projected into method, normalized path, joined query string, Content-Format, Accept, token, message id, and payload fields before routing.

interaction_units.name: resource_response
interaction_units.summary: The response envelope preserves token and message id, uses ACK for CON requests and NON for NON requests, and carries a response code plus optional options and payload.

core_flows.name: resource_discovery
core_flows.summary: Client sends GET /.well-known/core; server returns discoverable resource links in application/link-format when Accept is absent or link-format.

core_flows.name: hello_resource_read
core_flows.summary: Client sends GET /hello; server returns a text/plain greeting and changes the greeting text when a URI Query is present.

core_flows.name: echo_payload
core_flows.summary: Client sends POST or PUT /echo with a payload; server echoes the bytes with 2.04 Changed and preserves request Content-Format when present.

core_flows.name: kv_list
core_flows.summary: Client sends GET /kv; server returns a JSON array of stored keys.

core_flows.name: kv_create_or_update
core_flows.summary: Client sends PUT or POST /kv/<key>; server stores the payload in memory, returns 2.01 Created for a new key, and returns 2.04 Changed for an existing key.

core_flows.name: kv_read
core_flows.summary: Client sends GET /kv/<key>; server returns stored bytes with the stored Content-Format or application/octet-stream when no format was stored.

core_flows.name: kv_delete
core_flows.summary: Client sends DELETE /kv/<key>; server deletes an existing key and returns 2.02 Deleted, or 4.04 Not Found when the key does not exist.

core_flows.name: malformed_confirmable_request
core_flows.summary: If a malformed datagram is at least four bytes and its type is CON, the server sends an empty RST with the request message id.

surface_catalog.name: CON
surface_catalog.summary: Confirmable request type; the server responds with ACK for valid method requests or RST for malformed CON datagrams when the message id can be read.

surface_catalog.name: NON
surface_catalog.summary: Non-confirmable request type; the server returns NON responses for valid NON method requests.

surface_catalog.name: ACK
surface_catalog.summary: Acknowledgement response type used by this server for valid CON method requests.

surface_catalog.name: RST
surface_catalog.summary: Reset response type used when a malformed CON datagram has a readable message id.

surface_catalog.name: POST
surface_catalog.summary: Writes /echo or /kv/<key> resources with request payload bytes.

surface_catalog.name: PUT
surface_catalog.summary: Writes /echo or /kv/<key> resources with request payload bytes.

surface_catalog.name: 2.01 Created
surface_catalog.summary: Returned when PUT or POST creates a new /kv/<key> entry.

surface_catalog.name: 2.02 Deleted
surface_catalog.summary: Returned when DELETE removes an existing /kv/<key> entry.

surface_catalog.name: 2.05 Content
surface_catalog.summary: Returned for successful discovery, /hello, /kv, and /kv/<key> reads.

surface_catalog.name: 4.00 Bad Request
surface_catalog.summary: Returned when /kv is addressed without a key for non-GET methods.

surface_catalog.name: 4.04 Not Found
surface_catalog.summary: Returned when no resource route matches or a requested /kv/<key> is absent.

surface_catalog.name: 4.05 Method Not Allowed
surface_catalog.summary: Returned by the router when a matching resource exists but its method mask does not include the request method.

surface_catalog.name: 4.06 Not Acceptable
surface_catalog.summary: Returned by discovery when an Accept option is present and is not application/link-format.

surface_catalog.name: 5.00 Internal Server Error
surface_catalog.summary: Returned on selected allocation or request-view construction failures.

message_or_command_entries.name: coap_header
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: byte0 version/type/token_length, byte1 code, byte2-3 message_id
message_or_command_entries.summary: The first four bytes carry version, type, token length, code, and message id.

fields.name: version
fields.summary: Two-bit version field; decoder accepts only version 1 and encoder requires version 1.

fields.name: type
fields.summary: Two-bit message type mapped to CON, NON, ACK, or RST.

fields.name: token_len
fields.summary: Low four bits of byte0; values above 8 are rejected by decoder and encoder.

fields.name: code
fields.summary: One byte interpreted as method code for requests or class/detail response code for responses.

fields.name: message_id
fields.summary: Unsigned 16-bit message id copied from valid requests into responses and used for malformed CON resets.

message_or_command_entries.name: token
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: 0 to 8 bytes immediately after the 4-byte header
message_or_command_entries.summary: The server copies the request token into each valid response envelope.

fields.name: token_bytes
fields.summary: Opaque token bytes with maximum length 8.

message_or_command_entries.name: options
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: ordered sequence of option delta/length bytes with optional extended delta and length bytes
message_or_command_entries.summary: Options are decoded as cumulative option numbers and encoded only when option numbers are nondecreasing.

fields.name: option_delta
fields.summary: High nibble of each option header byte; values 13 and 14 use extended encoding and value 15 is invalid.

fields.name: option_length
fields.summary: Low nibble of each option header byte; values 13 and 14 use extended encoding and value 15 is invalid.

fields.name: uri_path
fields.summary: Repeated option number 11 segments are joined with '/' and normalized to a leading slash.

fields.name: content_format
fields.summary: Option number 12 is parsed as an unsigned integer and used by /echo and /kv storage/response logic.

fields.name: uri_query
fields.summary: Repeated option number 15 segments are joined with '&' for request handlers.

fields.name: accept
fields.summary: Option number 17 is parsed as an unsigned integer; discovery rejects Accept values other than link-format.

message_or_command_entries.name: payload
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: optional 0xff payload marker followed by opaque payload bytes
message_or_command_entries.summary: The decoder treats all bytes after a payload marker as opaque payload; encoder emits the marker only when payload length is greater than zero.

fields.name: payload_bytes
fields.summary: Opaque application payload used by /echo and /kv writes.

message_or_command_entries.name: request_view
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: method, path, query, content_format, accept, original message pointer
message_or_command_entries.summary: Server-side view built from a decoded method request before resource dispatch.

fields.name: method
fields.summary: Request code must be one of GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.

fields.name: path
fields.summary: Joined URI Path; empty path is normalized to '/'.

fields.name: query
fields.summary: Joined URI Query string; empty string when no URI Query option is present.

field_constraints.required_action: decoder rejects the message as invalid
decoder rejects the message as invalid; encoder refuses to encode

field_constraints.condition: datagram length is less than 4 or shorter than header plus token
option delta nibble or option length nibble is 15
field_constraints.required_action: decoder rejects the message as invalid

field_constraints.condition: encoded options are not in nondecreasing option-number order
field_constraints.required_action: encoder refuses to encode the message

field_constraints.condition: request code is not GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE
field_constraints.required_action: server frees the decoded message and sends no response

state_nodes.name: udp_server_running
state_nodes.summary: UDP socket and epoll file descriptor are open, registered for EPOLLIN, and the server loop is running.

state_nodes.name: decoded_request
state_nodes.summary: One datagram has been decoded into a coap_message_t and is ready for method validation and request-view construction.

state_nodes.name: resource_dispatch
state_nodes.summary: A valid method request has a normalized request view and is being matched against resource entries and method masks.

state_nodes.name: kv_entry_present
state_nodes.summary: An in-memory /kv/<key> record exists with key, payload bytes, and optional stored Content-Format.

state_nodes.name: response_encoded
state_nodes.summary: A response message has been populated, encoded into bytes, sent to the request peer, and then freed.

transitions.summary: The datagram callback decodes the packet and logs type, response-code class/detail representation, and message id.

transitions.trigger: malformed NON datagram or datagram shorter than 4 bytes
transitions.summary: The server drops malformed input without a response when it cannot or should not send a reset.

transitions.trigger: malformed CON datagram with readable message id
transitions.summary: The server sends an empty RST response carrying the request message id.

transitions.trigger: GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE request code
transitions.summary: The server creates a response envelope and request view, then dispatches by URI path and method.

transitions.trigger: PUT or POST /kv/<key> for a missing key
transitions.summary: The server allocates a new key-value entry, stores payload bytes, and returns 2.01 Created.

transitions.trigger: PUT or POST /kv/<key> for an existing key
transitions.summary: The server replaces the stored value and returns 2.04 Changed.
The server frees the key-value entry, compacts the in-memory array, and returns 2.02 Deleted.

transitions.trigger: handler success, handler error response, route miss, or method-mask miss
transitions.summary: The server sends the populated CoAP response to the peer endpoint.

timers_and_constants.name: default_port
timers_and_constants.value_or_rule: 5683 unless overridden by a valid command-line port.

timers_and_constants.name: option_extended_delta_or_length
timers_and_constants.value_or_rule: nibble < 13 inline, nibble 13 uses one extra byte plus 13, nibble 14 uses two extra bytes plus 269, nibble 15 invalid.

invariants.summary: Each incoming datagram is decoded and processed independently; the server does not retain per-peer request state for deduplication, retransmission, Observe, or Block transfer.
Valid CON method requests receive ACK responses; valid NON method requests receive NON responses.
Valid responses copy the request message id and token.
Resource routing is server-local and keyed by normalized URI path plus method mask.
The /kv store is memory-only and is destroyed with the server process.

dispatch_keys.name: method_code
dispatch_keys.summary: Resource dispatch uses GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE method bits.

dispatch_keys.name: uri_path
dispatch_keys.summary: Repeated URI Path options are joined into a normalized path and matched against resource entries.

dispatch_keys.name: prefix_match
dispatch_keys.summary: The /kv route is registered as a prefix route and matches /kv and /kv/<key> path forms.

dispatch_keys.name: accept
dispatch_keys.summary: The discovery handler uses the Accept option to decide whether link-format can be returned.

dispatch_keys.name: content_format
dispatch_keys.summary: The /echo and /kv handlers use Content-Format to select response format or persist stored value metadata.

dispatch_targets.name: datagram_handler
dispatch_targets.summary: Central datagram callback decodes input, builds request/response objects, invokes the router, and sends responses.

dispatch_targets.name: resource_router
dispatch_targets.summary: Router owns resource entries, method masks, exact/prefix path matching, and link-format discovery string generation.

dispatch_targets.name: discovery_handler
dispatch_targets.summary: Handles GET /.well-known/core and returns discoverable route metadata.

dispatch_targets.name: hello_handler
dispatch_targets.summary: Handles GET /hello and returns text/plain greeting content.

dispatch_targets.name: echo_handler
dispatch_targets.summary: Handles POST and PUT /echo by returning request payload bytes.

dispatch_targets.name: kv_handler
dispatch_targets.summary: Handles /kv and /kv/<key> list, read, write, and delete operations backed by memory.

matching_rules.summary: Exact-match resource entries match only when the registered path equals the normalized request path.
Prefix-match resource entries match when the request path starts with the registered path and the next character is end-of-string or '/'.
When a matching route exists but the method bit is absent from its method mask, the router returns 4.05 Method Not Allowed.
If no route matches, the datagram handler returns 4.04 Not Found.
Discovery output includes only entries registered as discoverable and serializes them as comma-separated link-format entries.

resource_objects.name: coap_udp_server
resource_objects.summary: Owns UDP socket fd, epoll fd, running flag, callbacks, configured port, and user pointer.

resource_objects.name: coap_message
resource_objects.summary: Represents version, type, code, message id, token, dynamic options, and dynamic payload.

resource_objects.name: coap_request_view
resource_objects.summary: Temporary request view that stores method, path, query, content_format, accept, and a pointer to the decoded message.

resource_objects.name: resource_entry
resource_objects.summary: Router entry with path, prefix flag, method mask, discoverable flag, link attributes, handler, and handler user pointer.

resource_objects.name: kv_entry
resource_objects.summary: In-memory key-value record containing key, value bytes, value length, stored Content-Format, and has_content_format flag.

resource_objects.name: coap_endpoint
resource_objects.summary: Peer address and address length captured from recvfrom and reused for sendto.

lifecycle_rules.summary: Server creation allocates the router, creates the UDP runtime, and registers discovery, hello, echo, and kv resources.
UDP start creates a nonblocking IPv4 datagram socket, binds it, creates epoll, and registers EPOLLIN.
Each decoded request message, response message, and request view is freed after datagram processing.
PUT and POST allocate or replace kv_entry value storage; DELETE and server destroy free key/value allocations.
Server destroy stops the UDP runtime, destroys the router, frees all key-value entries, and releases the server object.

persistence_scope.name: in_memory_only
persistence_scope.summary: The example server does not persist resource data across process restarts and has no durable storage layer.

error_matrix.required_action: decoder returns INVALID or TRUNCATED; server sends RST only when the datagram is at least four bytes and type is CON

error_matrix.condition: Decoded request code is not GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE
error_matrix.required_action: server ignores the message and sends no response

error_matrix.condition: No route matches the normalized URI path
Route matches but method is not allowed
GET /.well-known/core has Accept option other than application/link-format
Non-GET method targets /kv without a key suffix
Allocation fails while building discovery links, JSON key list, key-value storage, or request view
error_matrix.required_action: server replies 5.00 Internal Server Error when a response can be formed

fixed_protocol_constants.name: supported_message_types
fixed_protocol_constants.value_or_rule: CON, NON, ACK, and RST enum values are defined; request handling is implemented for CON/NON method requests and server-generated ACK/NON/RST responses.

defaults.name: kv_read_default_content_format
defaults.value_or_rule: application/octet-stream when the stored entry does not have an explicit Content-Format

recommended_values.name: validation_profile
recommended_values.value_or_rule: Use coap-client-notls against localhost UDP port 5683 for /hello, /.well-known/core, /echo, and /kv flows.

hard_bounds.name: option_length_storage
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: Option values are stored with uint16_t length; coap_message_add_option rejects lengths above UINT16_MAX.

hard_bounds.name: uint_option_length
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: Unsigned integer options longer than four bytes are treated as absent by coap_message_get_uint_option.

configurable_bounds.name: listen_port
configurable_bounds.value_or_rule: Server accepts an optional command-line port if it is between 1 and 65535.

security.name: authentication
security.summary: Authentication and authorization are not implemented in this example scope.

security.name: dtls
security.summary: DTLS is explicitly outside the current example scope; transport is plain UDP.

must_support_surface.name: CoAP over UDP
must_support_surface.summary: Listen on UDP, decode one CoAP message per datagram, and reply to the datagram peer.

must_support_surface.name: CON and NON requests
must_support_surface.summary: Handle valid CON and NON method requests and produce ACK or NON responses respectively.

must_support_surface.name: CoAP header, token, options, and payload codec
must_support_surface.summary: Decode and encode version, type, code, message id, token, ordered options, payload marker, and payload bytes.

must_support_surface.name: URI Path and URI Query
must_support_surface.summary: Join repeated URI Path options with '/' and repeated URI Query options with '&'.

must_support_surface.name: Content-Format and Accept
must_support_surface.summary: Parse unsigned Content-Format and Accept options for resource handlers.

must_support_surface.name: /echo
must_support_surface.summary: Echo payload bytes for POST and PUT.

must_support_surface.name: /kv and /kv/<key>
must_support_surface.summary: Provide in-memory list, create, update, read, and delete behavior.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: datagram_scoped_processing
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Process each UDP datagram independently without connection-level buffering.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: response_envelope
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Copy token and message id from requests, and choose ACK for CON or NON for NON.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: kv_lifecycle
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Keep key-value records in memory until DELETE or server destruction.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: resource_registration
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Register discovery, hello, echo, and kv routes during server creation.

must_support_error_paths.name: malformed_confirmable_reset
must_support_error_paths.summary: Send RST for malformed CON datagrams when a message id is available.

must_support_error_paths.name: not_found
must_support_error_paths.summary: Return 4.04 for unmatched routes and missing /kv/<key> reads/deletes.

must_support_error_paths.name: method_not_allowed
must_support_error_paths.summary: Return 4.05 when a route exists but the method mask rejects the request method.

must_support_error_paths.name: discovery_not_acceptable
must_support_error_paths.summary: Return 4.06 when discovery cannot satisfy the Accept option.

must_support_error_paths.name: bad_kv_collection_write
must_support_error_paths.summary: Return 4.00 when a non-GET /kv request omits the key suffix.

must_support_limits.name: token_length_bound
must_support_limits.summary: Reject token lengths above eight bytes.

must_support_limits.name: datagram_buffer_bound
must_support_limits.summary: Receive datagrams into a 1500-byte runtime buffer.

must_support_limits.name: option_extended_encoding
must_support_limits.summary: Support option delta and length extended encodings for nibble values 13 and 14; reject nibble 15.

may_defer_features.name: DTLS
may_defer_features.summary: Secure CoAP over DTLS is outside this example scope.

may_defer_features.name: Observe
may_defer_features.summary: Observe registration, notifications, and cancellation are outside this example scope.

may_defer_features.name: Block1_Block2
may_defer_features.summary: Block-wise transfer and payload fragmentation/reassembly are outside this example scope.

may_defer_features.name: deduplication_cache
may_defer_features.summary: Duplicate detection cache is outside this example scope.

may_defer_features.name: retransmission_state_machine
may_defer_features.summary: CON retransmission timers and acknowledgement tracking are outside this example scope.

may_defer_features.name: separate_responses
may_defer_features.summary: The server always builds immediate piggybacked ACK responses for valid CON requests and does not implement separate response handling.

may_defer_features.name: 4.13_payload_too_large_enforcement
may_defer_features.summary: README lists 4.13 as a common response code, but the current handler code does not emit it.

implementation_assumptions.name: server_only_target
implementation_assumptions.summary: The downstream target should generate CoAP server code; clients are external tools used for validation.

implementation_assumptions.name: plain_udp_only
implementation_assumptions.summary: The minimum runnable server uses plain UDP and omits DTLS.

implementation_assumptions.name: in_memory_runtime
implementation_assumptions.summary: Resource registry and /kv data are in memory and tied to the server process lifetime.

planning_inputs.protocol_summary: Minimal CoAP server subset implemented in C over UDP + epoll. The planning target is a server that handles CON/NON method requests, decodes CoAP headers/options/payloads, dispatches URI resources, returns immediate ACK/NON responses, implements /.well-known/core, /hello, /echo, and an in-memory /kv store, and intentionally defers DTLS, Observe, Block-wise transfer, deduplication, and retransmission state.
planning_checklist: 传输层与 datagram 运行模型
报文模型与 CoAP codec 范围
请求视图与 URI option 处理
响应 envelope 与 response code 设计
内存资源状态与生命周期
错误路径与 RST 行为
required_codec_scope: token decode and encode with maximum length 8
option delta and length extended encoding
Uri-Path, Uri-Query, Content-Format, and Accept options
payload marker and opaque payload bytes
RST encode for malformed CON datagrams
implementation_axes: UDP event loop and peer endpoint handling
critical_stateful_behaviors: Each datagram is processed independently and responses are sent to the recvfrom peer endpoint.
CON requests receive ACK responses; NON requests receive NON responses.
Tokens and message ids are copied into valid responses.
The /kv resource stores payload bytes and optional Content-Format in memory until DELETE or server destruction.
error_handling_obligations: Send RST for malformed CON datagrams when the type and message id can be read.
Return 4.04 for route misses and missing /kv entries.
Record 4.13 as documented but not currently emitted by implementation code.
persistence_and_lifecycle_obligations: Free decoded request messages, response messages, and request views after each datagram.
Free all kv entries and router resources during server destruction.
coverage_gaps: CON retransmission timers and acknowledgement tracking
implementation_risks: README lists 4.13, but the current code does not contain a response path that emits coap_make_code(4, 13).
The runtime receive buffer is 1500 bytes and there is no Block-wise transfer support, so larger payload interoperability is intentionally limited.
Non-method CoAP messages are silently ignored after decoding, which may need an explicit planning policy if broader interoperability is required.
The UDP socket is created as AF_INET; endpoint formatting supports IPv6, but the runtime listener is IPv4-only.
consistency_findings: README, message enums, codec, server handler, and resource router agree on the minimum CoAP over UDP server surface.
The supported README features map directly to implemented routes for /.well-known/core, /hello, /echo, /kv, and /kv/<key>.
The README limitation list matches absent implementation state for DTLS, Observe, Block-wise transfer, deduplication, and retransmission.

open_questions.question: Should the planning agent preserve the current lack of 4.13 Payload Too Large enforcement, or should generated protocol specs add a payload-size check because README lists 4.13?
open_questions.suggested_followup: For exact parity with the example project, keep 4.13 documented-but-not-emitted; for stronger CoAP behavior, define a payload limit and response path.

open_questions.question: Should minimum_v1 include duplicate detection and CON retransmission state, or intentionally mirror the current stateless datagram processing?
open_questions.suggested_followup: Keep deduplication and retransmission deferred for the current min implementation; add them only when expanding beyond the example scope.

open_questions.question: Should unsupported non-method CoAP messages receive RST or remain silently ignored as in the current server path?
open_questions.suggested_followup: For parity, preserve silent ignore after successful decode; for stricter interoperability, define explicit response behavior per message type.

evidence_index.excerpt: Minimal CoAP server implemented over UDP, intended to keep common functionality runnable and code structure clear for extension.

Supported capabilities list CoAP over UDP, CON/NON requests, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, Token, Message ID, URI Path, URI Query, Content-Format, Accept, common response codes, /.well-known/core, and /hello, /echo, /kv resources.
The server executable runs as ./coap_server [port], defaults to 5683, and quick tests use coap-client-notls for /hello, /.well-known/core, /kv, and /echo.
Current scope excludes DTLS, Observe, Block1/Block2, deduplication cache, and retransmission state machine.
main defaults to port 5683, accepts a valid numeric command-line port, creates the server, starts it, runs it, and destroys it.

Definitions include max token length 8, message types CON/NON/ACK/RST, methods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, option numbers Uri-Path/Content-Format/Uri-Query/Accept, content formats, and coap_message_t fields.
Message helpers initialize version 1, copy tokens, allocate payloads/options, join repeated options, parse uint options up to four bytes, and compute code class/detail.
Decoder parses the 4-byte header, validates version and token length, copies token, decodes ordered options with extended delta/length, handles payload marker, and returns OK, INVALID, or TRUNCATED.
Encoder validates version and token length, computes encoded size, requires nondecreasing option numbers, encodes extended delta/length, writes payload marker when needed, and returns bytes.
Response envelope initializes version 1, sets ACK for CON requests or NON otherwise, copies message id, and copies the request token.
Request view requires a method code, joins URI Path with '/', joins URI Query with '&', normalizes empty path to '/', prefixes missing leading slash, and parses Content-Format and Accept.

on_datagram decodes input, sends RST for malformed CON messages with a readable message id, ignores non-method messages, dispatches valid request views, maps route misses to 4.04, sends responses, and frees message state.
Discovery rejects non-link-format Accept with 4.06, builds core links from the router, returns 5.00 on allocation failure, and sends 2.05 with application/link-format on success.
Hello returns text/plain 2.05 content and uses alternate text when the request query string is nonempty.
Echo returns 2.04 Changed with request payload bytes and uses request Content-Format when present, otherwise text/plain.

KV helpers find, create/update, and delete entries; handle_kv lists keys as JSON for GET /kv, reads keys, writes payload bytes with optional Content-Format, deletes keys, and returns 2.01/2.02/2.04/2.05/4.00/4.04/4.05/5.00 as appropriate.
Server creation registers /.well-known/core, /hello, /echo, and prefix /kv routes with method masks and discovery attributes; destroy stops UDP, destroys router, and frees key-value entries.
coap_request_t exposes message, method, path, query, content_format, has_content_format, accept, and has_accept; router API creates, destroys, adds, dispatches, and builds core links.

evidence_index.section_hint: Resource entry matching and core link generation
evidence_index.excerpt: Router entries include path, prefix_match, methods_mask, discoverable, attributes, handler, and user; dispatch supports exact and slash-boundary prefix matching, method masks, and link-format discovery output.
UDP API defines coap_endpoint_t with sockaddr_storage and addr_len, datagram callback signature, server lifecycle functions, sendto, and endpoint-to-string helper.

UDP runtime creates a nonblocking AF_INET SOCK_DGRAM socket, sets SO_REUSEADDR, binds to INADDR_ANY, registers EPOLLIN, receives datagrams into a 1500-byte buffer with recvfrom, and sends responses with sendto.
